description: Welcome to Team LONOS. I am Puneeth Nunna, a current high school junior attending the Massachusetts Academy of Math and Science @ WPI. My interests are in engineering and aerospace as well, as I've done much of my research in this area. I've attended and participated in numerous hackathons in the past and won a few. My friends and I have hosted our own recently. I would love to partner with students who share some of my interests as well, and I wish the best for everyone.
